instructions: The linked clause lists items its spec excludes as non-goals. Does the changed clause add or require something the non-goal excludes? Answer yes only when you can name the specific listed item the changed clause adds or requires. Answer no when the changed clause does not add any item the non-goal lists, even when the wording overlaps.

labels.name: yes
labels.description: The changed clause adds or requires something the non-goal linked clause excludes.
